met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure area oversoutheast Rajasthan & neighbourhood now lies over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 1430 Hrs IST of today, 24th July, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 9.4 km above mean sea level tilting south-westwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, centre of low-pressure area over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood, Kota, Guna, Sidhi, Daltonganj & thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northern parts of Gangetic West Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh extending upto 9.4 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height persists. Under its influence a low pressure area likely to form over the same region during next 24 hours.
The trough now runs from cyclonic circulation associated with the Low-Pressure area over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood to Jammu across West Rajasthan, Haryana & Punjab between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists. The weak offshore trough at the mean sea level from Gujarat to Karnataka coast persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
